warrior.intro: Build Rage in close combat, then spend it on damage or threat. Choose Arms for a two-handed weapon, Fury for two weapons, or Protection for a shield.
warrior.spec1: Arms rewards timing and heavy weapon hits. Keep Rend active, take Overpower openings, and use Spearing Strike when its extra damage applies.
warrior.spec2: Fury favors steady dual-wield pressure. Keep your attack speed effects active and spend surplus Rage on Bloodthirst, Whirlwind and finishing attacks.
warrior.spec3: Protection controls enemies with a shield. Build threat with Shield Slam, Revenge and Sunder Armor; Tactical Mastery makes stance changes less punishing.

paladin.intro: Seals and Judgements support three distinct roles. Paladins can heal, protect a group, or deal melee damage with a two-handed weapon.
paladin.spec1: Holy focuses on efficient direct heals. Use Holy Light for large damage spikes, Flash of Light for quick recovery, and Light's Vigil for group healing.
paladin.spec2: Protection combines a shield with holy threat. Maintain Seal of Fury, use Judgement of Fury to control targets, and cleave with Hammer of the Righteous.
paladin.spec3: Retribution builds around weapon swings, seals and critical hits. Weave Judgements into combat and use Holy Strike as a regular instant attack.

hunter.intro: Fight at range with a pet, traps and stings, or choose Survival for melee. Pet management matters even before a specialization is chosen.
hunter.spec1: Beast Mastery puts the pet first. Keep it engaged, use Bestial Wrath for burst, and work Summon Hawk into your ranged attacks.
hunter.spec2: Marksmanship rewards careful ranged timing. Keep Auto Shot flowing, choose the right Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot window, and line up Sniper Shot safely.
hunter.spec3: Survival can fight in melee. Use Strider Kick to stay on a target, maintain Lacerate, and lean on parries and Counterattack for pressure.

rogue.intro: Build combo points with quick Energy attacks, then choose a finisher for damage or control. Stealth sets the terms of the first exchange.
rogue.spec1: Assassination centers on poisons and Mutilate. Build points on poisoned targets, then use Venom or another finisher at the right moment.
rogue.spec2: Combat favors sustained weapon damage. Keep Slice and Dice running, use Sinister Strike to build points, and save burst cooldowns for tougher enemies.
rogue.spec3: Subtlety rewards deliberate openers and short bursts. Start from stealth, build with Hemorrhage, and use Rupture when a fight will last.

priest.intro: Priests can prevent damage, restore health, or deal Shadow damage. Their race-specific spells add options, but the three healing and damage paths stay distinct.
priest.spec1: Discipline protects allies before damage lands. Combine Power Word: Shield with efficient heals and Penance for a flexible burst response.
priest.spec2: Holy is the direct healing path. Match a large heal or quick heal to the situation, and use Prayer of Mending for repeated group damage.
priest.spec3: Shadow keeps damage-over-time effects active and channels between them. Use Shadow Word: Death to finish targets when the backlash is safe.

shaman.intro: Totems support the whole party while your specialization chooses spell damage, melee combat, or healing. Set up the right totems before a difficult pull.
shaman.spec1: Elemental pairs Flame Shock with Lava Burst, then fills with Lightning Bolt. Chain Lightning handles grouped enemies.
shaman.spec2: Enhancement fights in melee with weapon buffs and Stormstrike. Call of the Elements can place a prepared totem set in one cast.
shaman.spec3: Restoration heals groups with Chain Heal. Put Riptide on the main target first, then use direct heals between damage spikes.

mage.intro: Mages trade armor for powerful ranged spells, control and area damage. Choose Arcane for resource planning, Fire for damage over time, or Frost for safety.
mage.spec1: Arcane builds Arcane Blast stacks, then spends their bonus on another spell while watching the rising Mana cost.
mage.spec2: Fire builds pressure with Scorch and Ignite, then uses Combustion for burst. Wake of Fire helps carry momentum between targets.
mage.spec3: Frost controls space with slows and freezes. Follow a frozen target with Ice Lance, and use defensive tools to keep distance.

warlock.intro: Warlocks sustain spell damage with curses, banes, demons and Life Tap. Manage health and Mana together rather than casting until empty.
warlock.spec1: Affliction layers damage-over-time effects before channeling Wrack. Keep a Curse and Bane of Agony working on longer fights.
warlock.spec2: Demonology draws strength from a demon companion. Choose between keeping the demon active for durability or sacrificing it for personal damage.
warlock.spec3: Destruction builds fire damage around Immolate and Incinerate. Refresh the setup after Conflagrate consumes it for burst.

druid.intro: Shapeshifting lets Druids fill several roles. Balance casts spells, Feral tanks or fights in cat form, and Restoration heals over time.
druid.spec1: Balance uses Moonfire and Insect Swarm while alternating Starfire and Wrath. Position early so longer casts can finish safely.
druid.spec2: Feral switches between bear protection and cat damage. Bear uses Lacerate for threat; Feral Charge helps reach or control a target.
druid.spec3: Restoration keeps healing-over-time effects on allies. Use Swiftmend for sudden damage and Wild Growth when several players need help.

dawnWaker.spiritDescription: Equip Ancient Heirloom and carry the globe to Highborne Spirit. Kill Narassin for Azsharan Key; open the box behind him for his tome. Return to the spirit, then speak to Mordent Evenshade in Shen’dralas (35.05, 46.49).

dawnWaker.chestDescription: Abyssal Chest: underwater in Azshara; complete the Kirith–Azsharite quest chain first. Tears of Anguish: after speaking to Mordent, defeat Anguished or Suffering Highborne near Lake Kel’theril. The ring is not required for these drops.
dawnWaker.tearsDescription: Abyssal Chest: underwater in Azshara; complete the Kirith–Azsharite quest chain first. Tears of Anguish: after speaking to Mordent, defeat Anguished or Suffering Highborne near Lake Kel’theril. The ring is not required for these drops.
dawnWaker.shrineDescription: Return to Mordent. At Shrine of Coalescence, use the globe with all three cleansing items. Return with Cleansed Water Globe, then speak to Prince Tortheldrin in Dire Maul. Further steps and an Honored reputation requirement are not confirmed.

november16Notes.xp: A dungeon enemy grants no XP to anyone in the party if the highest-level member is 13 or more levels above that enemy.
november16Notes.alcaz: For the secret disguise, leave The Questioner alive until you accept The Man in the Iron Chains at the end of the dungeon. Continue through Moonbrook, then Stormwind (Alliance) or Booty Bay (Horde). Combine 6 Fractured Insignias to create the Alcaz Operative Insignia.
november16Notes.brd: East of the Ring of Law, clear the enemies on the bridge heading north over the lava. The nearby jumping route leads to Traveler's Symbols, Student Fodder and Premo's Poise-Demanding Uniform.
november16Notes.diremaul: At level 60, pick up In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities from Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay. It needs items from Alzzin the Wildshaper (east), Prince Tortheldrin (west) and King Gordok (north). The weekly reward is an Undermine Satchel.
november16Notes.spire: Alliance: completing The End of the Dark Horde with Rend's head grants Might of Stormwind for 1 hour: 300 health, 15% melee and spell haste, and 10 mana per 5 seconds. The buff cannot be used in raids.
november16Notes.krol: The five-piece Krol'dok Battlegear set can transform its wearer into an ogre when its effect reaches full stacks.
november16Notes.ring: Until raids open, Pix Xizzix offers an irreversible exchange of Blessed Band of Light for Channeler's Ring to players carrying the band.
november16Notes.druid: Wild Growth requires you to stand still while casting. Its healing coefficient is now 6.6%, up from 3.3%.
november16Notes.mage: Frost Nova can now break from Blizzard damage and damage procs.
november16Notes.paladin: Judgement of Command counts as a melee attack and triggers on-hit effects. The other Judgements remain ranged attacks.
november16Notes.priest: The Quick and the Dead now correctly reduces Divine Spirit's mana cost.
november16Notes.shaman: Windfury Totem can trigger from melee abilities without a main-hand attack. Off-hand hits from Whirlwind or Mutilate cannot trigger it; their main-hand hits can.
november16Notes.warlock: Rank 1 Siphon Life cannot be cast while silenced.
november16Notes.warrior: Berserker Rage now removes Sap correctly.
november16Notes.stuns: Stun diminishing returns now work both when creatures stun players and when players stun creatures.
